program:
root = Stack([header, kpis, tabs], 16)
dashData = Query("host_getDashboard", {}, {"clientsMissingDocs": 0, "documentsOutstanding": 0, "documentsReceived": 0, "documentsTotal": 0, "clientsTotal": 0, "nearestDeadline": "", "nearestDeadlineClient": {"id": "", "businessName": "", "filingDeadline": ""}})
deadlinesData = Query("host_listDeadlines", {}, [])
header = Stack([title, subtitle], 4)
title = Text("30-Day Filing Deadline Board", "heading")
subtitle = Text("Track tax filing deadlines, document collection status, and team assignments for upcoming client filings.", "caption")
kpis = Row([stat1, stat2, stat3, stat4], 12)
stat1 = Stat("Total Active Clients", dashData.clientsTotal, "number")
stat2 = Stat("Clients Missing Docs", dashData.clientsMissingDocs, "number", null, "danger")
stat3 = Stat("Outstanding Documents", dashData.documentsOutstanding, "number", null, "warning")
stat4 = Stat("Nearest Deadline Date", dashData.nearestDeadline, "date", null, "accent")
tabs = Tabs(tabList)
tabList = [{label: "Deadline Schedule", content: table}, {label: "Client Overview Cards", content: cardList}]
table = DataTable(deadlinesData, cols, "filingDeadline asc", 50, ["status", "entityType"], true, 10, "No client deadlines scheduled.")
cols = [{key: "businessName", label: "Client Name"}, {key: "entityType", label: "Tax Form / Entity"}, {key: "filingDeadline", label: "Filing Deadline", format: "date"}, {key: "status", label: "Status"}, {key: "assignee.name", label: "Assigned Staff"}]
cardList = CardList(deadlinesData, "businessName", "status", cardFields, 2, "No client cards available.")
cardFields = [{key: "entityType", label: "Tax Entity"}, {key: "filingDeadline", label: "Filing Deadline", format: "date"}, {key: "assignee.name", label: "Assigned Staff"}]
